title: Surreal Cosmic Wanderer
description: An elderly man in a green coat and hat walks with a cane along a cracked white road in a dark surreal landscape. A blue robot with a screen head rides on his back while a green figure stands inside a crystal ball to his right.
prompt: Surreal night scene of an elderly man wearing a green overcoat and hat walking with a cane on a cracked white road. A small blue robot with a screen face rides piggyback on him. To his right is a large crystal ball containing a tiny green figure. In the background is a red ringed planet with geometric patterns, purple lavender fields on one side, orange and purple smoke, constellations, a bat-like creature, and floating geometric shapes against a black sky.
